The Senior Sales Executive will be responsible for driving jewellery sales, achieving assigned sales targets, handling customers professionally, providing accurate product information, generating repeat business and ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

The candidate must have strong experience in the **jewellery retail industry** and should be confident in handling gold and diamond jewellery customers, including high-value customers.

**2. Sales Achievement**

* Convert showroom walk-ins into successful sales.
* Drive sales through effective product presentation and customer engagement.
* Upsell and cross-sell suitable jewellery products.
* Promote new collections, offers and special products.
* Focus on increasing average bill value and overall sales conversion.
* Develop repeat business and customer referrals.

**B. Customer Handling**

* Welcome and attend customers in a professional and courteous manner.
* Understand customer requirements, preferences, occasion and budget.
* Recommend suitable jewellery designs according to the customer's needs.
* Handle premium and high-value customers with proper attention and professionalism.
* Explain product details, weight, purity, making charges, pricing and other applicable information accurately.
* Build strong and long-term relationships with customers.
* Resolve customer queries professionally and escalate complaints when required.

**C. Jewellery Product Knowledge**

* Maintain strong knowledge of gold, diamond and other jewellery products.
* Understand basic jewellery terminology, purity, hallmarking and diamond specifications.
* Keep updated about new collections, designs and market trends.
* Clearly explain product specifications and benefits to customers.
* Ensure that no incorrect or unauthorized information is communicated to customers.

**D. Customer Follow-Up & Lead Management**

* Follow up with prospective customers after showroom visits.
* Follow up on quotations, enquiries and pending purchase decisions.
* Maintain proper records of customer enquiries and follow-ups.
* Contact existing customers regarding new collections and relevant offers.
* Generate repeat sales through effective customer relationship management.
* Develop customer references and personal sales leads.

**E. Sales Process & Coordination**

* Follow the company's sales process and SOPs at all times.
* Ensure accurate customer information and required documentation.
* Coordinate with the billing and accounts teams for smooth completion of sales.
* Coordinate with purchase/stock teams whenever required.
* Ensure proper handover of jewellery for billing and delivery.
* Do not make any unauthorized commitment regarding discounts, pricing, exchange, delivery or other company policies.

**F. Team Support**

* Support Junior Sales Executives in customer handling and sales conversion.
* Guide junior team members regarding product presentation and customer service.
* Share product knowledge and effective sales techniques with team members.
* Assist the Senior Sales Officer / Store Manager in maintaining sales discipline.
* Support the team during rush hours and high customer footfall.
* Report customer concerns, operational issues and stock-related issues to the reporting manager immediately.

**G. Jewellery Handling & Security**

* Follow all jewellery handling and security procedures strictly.
* Handle jewellery carefully while showing products to customers.
* Ensure products are properly returned to their designated location after customer viewing.
* Follow showroom CCTV and security procedures.
* Ensure no jewellery is left unattended.
* Immediately report any discrepancy, damage, loss or suspicious activity to the reporting manager.

* Check daily sales targets and pending customer follow-ups.
* Attend customers promptly and professionally.
* Understand customer requirements and present suitable products.
* Conduct customer follow-ups and update records.
* Maintain proper product presentation.
* Ensure accurate communication of product and pricing details.
* Coordinate with billing, accounts and other departments when required.
* Support junior sales staff.
* Report daily sales performance and important customer matters to the reporting manager.

**4. KRAs / PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of assigned sales targets.
* Sales conversion rate.
* Average bill value.
* Number of successful customer conversions.
* Repeat customer sales.
* Follow-up and lead conversion.
* Customer satisfaction and service quality.
* Product knowledge.
* Jewellery handling and security compliance.
* Discipline and adherence to company SOPs.
* Team coordination and support.
* Professional behaviour and grooming.

**5. REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Strong jewellery sales experience.
* Hands on experience in diamond and gold calculation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong customer-handling ability.
* Good sales presentation and convincing skills.
* Negotiation and closing skills.
* Strong knowledge of gold and diamond jewellery.
* Ability to handle high-value customers.
* Target-oriented approach.
* Customer relationship management skills.
* Team coordination skills.
* Professional personality and positive attitude.

**6. EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATION**

* **Minimum Experience:** 3 years.
* **Mandatory Industry Experience:** Candidates must have prior experience in the **Jewellery Industry / Jewellery Retail Showroom**.
* Experience in **Gold, Diamond or Jewellery Showrooms** will be preferred.
* Candidates with experience in other retail industries but **without jewellery industry experience will not be considered**.
* **Qualification:** Graduate preferred.
* Candidates must possess strong jewellery product knowledge and sales experience.

**7. PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS & GROOMING**

* Strictly follow assigned duty timings.
* Maintain proper uniform, hygiene and professional grooming.
* Hair must be neatly tied in a bun.
* Maintain minimal and professional makeup.
* Wear minimal jewellery while on duty.
* Maintain a clean and organized sales area.
* Maintain respectful behaviour with customers, colleagues and seniors.
* Remain calm and professional during rush hours.
* Maintain showroom discipline and decorum.
* Follow all instructions issued by the reporting manager and management.

**8. CODE OF CONDUCT & CONFIDENTIALITY**

* Maintain professional conduct at all times.
* Treat customers, colleagues and seniors with respect.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information, company information, pricing and business-related data.
* Do not share confidential company or customer information with unauthorized persons.
* Do not use the company's name, contact details or office resources for personal purposes without authorization.
* Any misconduct, misbehaviour, negligence, dishonesty or violation of company policies may result in disciplinary action.

**9. REPORTING & ACCOUNTABILITY**

The Senior Sales Executive will be directly accountable for assigned sales targets, customer handling, follow-ups and overall sales performance.

All customer complaints, operational issues, stock discrepancies, suspicious activities or other important matters must be **immediately reported to the Senior Sales Officer / Store Manager**.

The employee is expected to take complete ownership of assigned customers and responsibilities and work towards achieving the showroom's overall sales objectives.

**10. EMPLOYEE EXPECTATION**

The Senior Sales Executive is expected to represent **Right Gold** professionally, maintain high standards of customer service, demonstrate strong jewellery knowledge and contribute consistently towards showroom sales and customer satisfaction.

description:
Purpose of the role

Generate and qualify pipeline by phone, email and LinkedIn, then either close smaller deals directly or hand larger ones to the senior sales team with a complete qualification record attached.

This is a volume role with a quality gate. You are measured on qualified meetings that happen and revenue that closes, not on calls dialled or emails sent.

Key responsibilities

**Outbound prospecting**

* Work assigned target lists daily: cold calls, emails and LinkedIn outreach to decision\-makers at target companies.
* Maintain the touch discipline: three touches maximum per prospect, no weekend contact, no apology or reference to delay in any re\-engagement message.
* Research each account before contact. Generic openers are not acceptable.
* Follow all applicable regulations on unsolicited contact. No messaging channels without a consent path.

**Inbound response**

* Respond to every inbound enquiry the same day it arrives. This is a hard requirement, not a target.
* Qualify the enquiry on need, budget, authority, timeline and current systems in the first conversation.
* Send a tiered written quotation on first contact where the requirement is clear. Do not withhold pricing behind a discovery call.

**Qualification**

* Qualify against the defined ideal customer profile: sector, size, existing systems, trigger event, decision unit.
* Identify the signatory, the day\-to\-day contact and the internal technical gatekeeper on every opportunity. Single\-threaded deals are flagged.
* Disqualify quickly and in writing. A clean disqualification is a result, not a failure.

**Closing and handover**

* Close deals value directly, from first contact to signed agreement.
* For larger opportunities, book the meeting and hand over a complete brief: contacts, pain, trigger, current systems, budget signal, competitive situation.
* Follow up every proposal on a defined cadence until you get a decision either way.

**CRM discipline**

* Log every call, email and meeting the same day.
* Every open opportunity carries a stage, value, next action and date at all times.
* Your pipeline is reviewed weekly. Inaccurate pipeline is treated as non\-performance.

**Commercial discipline**

* Quote from the published price list only. Never invent, round or estimate a price.
* Discount only after written pushback from the client, never in anticipation of it. Anchor at list.
* No verbal commitments on scope, timeline or support. Anything outside a written agreement is quoted as a variation before work starts.

Requirements

* 1 to 3 years in inside sales, telesales, business development or lead generation for a B2B product or service.
* Demonstrated cold\-calling capability. You will make outbound calls daily and you must be comfortable with rejection volume.
* Ability to hold a business conversation with an owner, director or department head without needing a script.
* Strong spoken and written English.

* Prior experience selling into the UAE or GCC market.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms as a product, not just as an internal tool.
* Experience in real estate technology, or selling to real estate brokerages.
